newsitem.title: USA: Donnelly to restructure European unit.
newsitem.headline: Donnelly to restructure European unit.

text.p: Donnelly Corp said Tuesday it will restructure its European operations at an after-tax cost of $4-$5 million, and take a charge of $0.42-$0.52 a share in fiscal 1997.

The restructuring is designed to realign the auto supplier's European manufacturing capacity and reduce operating costs. Donnelly said it has expanded its presence in Europe over the past two years with the acquisition of a mirror producer with manufacturing operations in Germany and Spain. Those operations are being integrated with others that Donnelly owns in Ireland and France.
Donnelly currently maintains six manufacturing operations in Germany, Ireland, France and Spain.

"Management has anticipated the need for restructuring in Europe and has now completed the preliminary plan to position our European operations for stronger financial performance," said Dwane Baumgardner, Donnelly chairman and chief executive officer, in a statement.
"These actions should bring the financial performance of our European operations more in line with our North American operations," he said.
